Extract edge and node sets from a dataframe

Parameters:

  • df (DataFrame) – DataFrame containing edges

  • protein1_col (str) – Column name for first protein

  • protein2_col (str) – Column name for second protein

Returns:

Tuple of (edge_set, node_set)

Tuple[Set, Set]
